focus: Behind the scenes this week: the homepage hero cover image is now loaded with the browser's fastest possible path — the image URL is in the HTML itself, so the browser starts fetching it immediately during page load instead of waiting for CSS to compute first. This closes a performance gap that had been keeping our Lighthouse score just below the 80% threshold. Also added diagnostic tracking (LCP, TBT, CLS) to our performance regression system so we can see exactly which metrics changed when scores shift.
nextStep: Coming soon: confirming the Lighthouse CI score has crossed the 80% threshold, and adding the seven new leaderboard category pages to the sitemap for search indexing.
